parts.t: Beach Grove is a community on the west side of Boundary Bay in Delta, with a park, a school, a golf club and the start of the Dyke Trail.

Written by Jared Gibbons, REALTOR®, Royal LePage Little Oak Realty, on October 11, 2026. I have worked in Lower Mainland real estate for 11+ years. Facts come from the official sources noted on this page. Rules and boundaries change, so confirm anything important with the City of Delta.
Not legal, planning or financial advice. Before you buy or sell, check the zoning, what the community plan says, and which schools serve the address.

blocks.text: What to look at in a Beach Grove home

parts.t: These are the questions I work through with buyers.

items.t: Lot size, the age of major systems, and the street
What the zone allows, and whether any suite was permitted
Assuming a neighbour’s rebuild or suite is possible on your lot

blocks.text: Golf course edge Homes near the club

parts.t: Which side of the lot faces the course, and any netting or fencing
Whether anyone else has a right to use part of the land (easements), or there are title rules (covenants) or club rules that affect it
Stray balls and early-morning maintenance noise on lots next to the course

blocks.text: Shoreline Boundary Bay and low lots

parts.t: How high the lot sits, drainage, and any rules on the title (covenants)
How high the living space must be built, and whether work on the shore needs a seawall designed by an engineer
Insurance costs or limits. Get a quote before you remove subjects (the conditions in your offer).
Delta adopted a new Official Community Plan in 2024. Zoning and what the plan says can be different for each lot.

Lots zoned for single detached or duplex homes can have up to 3 units (lots up to 280 square metres) or 4 units (larger lots), plus a secondary suite and coach or garden suites within the unit limits.
Low and waterfront lots may have a rule on the title (a covenant) that sets how high the living space must be built. Minimum flood elevations are shown on DeltaMap.

blocks.text: Before you buy in Beach Grove

parts.t: Ask the City of Delta what the property is zoned and what the plan says about it and the lots around it.
Use the Delta School District school locator for the exact address.
Ask whether the home was affected by the December 2022 flood advisory for Beach Grove and Boundary Bay, and what was repaired.
Ask whether it was permitted before you count on it.
Check the roof, drainage and major systems.
Ask Delta how high a home must be built for flooding, and read the title for any rules (covenants).
Send me your address and I’ll give you a call to talk about how to get the most value from your home.

Is there an official Beach Grove boundary?

Beach Grove is an official BC community name and an MLS® sub-area name in Tsawwassen with map lines set by the real estate board rather than a municipal boundary bylaw, so ask me about any specific address.
Is Beach Grove prone to flooding?

Delta issued a flood advisory for the Beach Grove and Boundary Bay communities in December 2022. Low lots may have a rule on the title that sets how high a home must be built, so check the exact property.
What parks are in Beach Grove?
at 1255 Beach Grove Court. The Dyke Trail starts at 17A Avenue.
Beach Grove Elementary is at 5955 17A Avenue. Check the Delta School District school locator for your address.
Is there a golf course in Beach Grove?
Yes. Beach Grove Golf Club, a private member-owned club, is at 5946 12 Avenue.
